'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] [[Shell (projectile)|shell]] Ukrainian-held areas of [[Kherson Oblast]], killing at least five [[civilian]]s, including a child, while 17 others are reportedly injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65630018 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Emilia-Romagna floods]]
**Eight people are killed in [[Province of Forlì-Cesena|Forlì–Cesena]], [[Ravenna]] and [[Bologna]], and 20,000 are evacuated during heavy [[floods]] in the region of [[Emilia-Romagna]], [[Italy]]. Twenty-three [[river]]s have overflowed their banks across the region. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-floods-drought-59db3225a5d4b170a1cb03c0ab40b000 (AP)]
**The [[2023 Emilia Romagna Grand Prix]], which was scheduled to be held at the [[Autodromo Internazionale Enzo e Dino Ferrari]] in [[Imola]] from May 19–21, is cancelled because of the floods. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/65621373 (BBC News)]
*[[Lu Peng Yuan Yu sinking|''Lu Peng Yuan Yu'' sinking]]
**The [[Chinese government]] reports that the fishing vessel ''Lu Peng Yuan Yu 028'' [[capsize]]d in the central [[Indian Ocean]] on Tuesday. [[China]] and other countries are conducting [[search and rescue|search operation]]s for 39 sailors, including [[Chinese people|Chinese]], [[Indonesians|Indonesian]], and [[Filipinos|Filipino]] nationals. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/rcna84808 (AP via NBC News)] [https://dw.com/en/china-39-missing-after-boat-capsizes-in-indian-ocean/a-65651314 (DW)]

'''Health and environment'''
*According to the [[World Meteorological Organization]], the global temperature will temporarily pass the threshold of 1.5&nbsp;°C above preindustrial levels, with a likelihood of 66%, by the year 2027, due to a combination of [[Climate change|climate change]] and [[El Niño]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-65602293 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Ukraine relations]]
**The [[Senate (France)|French Senate]] votes to recognize the 1932 [[Holodomor]] [[famine]] as a "[[genocide]]" of [[Ukrainians]]. [https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/910843.html (Interfax)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/29/french-mps-recognise-ukraine-soviet-era-famine-as-genocide (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Iran–Russia relations]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs an investment program deal that will make an investment of 1.6 billion [[Euro|euros]] in [[Iran]]ian railroad projects, which are expected to begin operation within 48 months. [https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2023/05/17/2896207/iran-russia-sign-deal-on-major-railroad-project (Tasnim)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Censorship of TikTok]], [[Restrictions on TikTok in the United States]]
**[[Montana Assembly Bill 419]]
***[[List of governors of Montana|Montana Governor]] [[Greg Gianforte]] signs a bill banning [[TikTok]], making [[Montana]] the first U.S. state to ban the [[China|Chinese]]-owned [[social media]] app. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/montana-governor-signs-bill-banning-tiktok-state-2023-05-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Capital punishment in Thailand]]
**A court in [[Thailand]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] the former mayor of [[Wang Wiset district]] [[capital punishment|to death]] for the [[murder]] of an activist in May 2021. The [[hitman]] received a sentence of [[life imprisonment]]. [https://thethaiger.com/hot-news/crime/mayor-sentenced-to-death-over-land-activists-murder-in-thailand (''The Thaiger'')]
*[[Siege of Nueva Concepción]]
**[[President of El Salvador|Salvadoran President]] [[Nayib Bukele]] deploys 5,000 [[Salvadoran Army|soldiers]] and 500 [[National Civil Police (El Salvador)|police officers]] to the northwestern town of [[Nueva Concepción]] in order to arrest suspects in connection with the killing of a policeman on Tuesday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-forces-surround-town-north-after-police-killing-2023-05-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Ecuadorian political crisis]]
**Amid ongoing impeachment proceedings, [[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian president]] [[Guillermo Lasso]] uses the ''[[muerte cruzada]]'' provision of the Constitution to dissolve the [[National Assembly (Ecuador)|National Assembly]]. [[2023 Ecuadorian general election|Fresh presidential and legislative elections]] will be held within 97 days, during which time Lasso will be able to rule by decree. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-65624035 (BBC News)]
